newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar ranged on sluggish festival demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar ranged on sluggish festival demand.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady in a narrow trading range on the local market, dealers said.
Fresh festival demand turned sluggish at the higher level but limited arrivals kept the market quiet.

"Government has increased supplies of sugar in the public distribution system ahead of Diwali festival, which reduced sugar offtake in the open market," one broker said. "Higher outstation buying led to limited arrivals from mills."
In ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,312/1,338 rupees per quintal while M-30 was steady at 1,340/1,370 rupees per quintal. --Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
